chunks: And through his chain of narrators, it was narrated that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

To Ali (peace be upon him): Whoever loves you will be with the Prophets in their rank on the Day of Resurrection, and whoever dies while hating you, it makes no difference to him whether he died as a Jew or a Christian.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of loving or hating Imam Ali (a.s.) according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores the Shia doctrine of *Wilayah* by linking love for Imam Ali directly to prophetic intercession and high spiritual rank. Conversely, it presents hatred for him as a definitive marker of *Kufr* (disbelief), illustrating how personal enmity toward the Ahl al-Bayt invalidates one's faith status regardless of outward religious affiliation.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: According to the same documentation, it is narrated that God’s Prophet (S) told Ali (a.s.), “Whoever loves you will be among the Prophets (a.s.) and with the same rank on the Resurrection Day. Whoever dies while he despises you, it is as if he has died as a Christian or a Jew.”
